The CodeQL Action will now try to identify if a workflow is about to perform a traced analysis on version 27 or above of macOS or Xcode. body:
## Summary

Fixes #20.

The workflow-dependency freshness check failed on **every** event whenever an upstream action or tool published a newer release. Scheduled runs on `main` therefore went red at an unchanged SHA (976d67f, four weeks in a row) for something the commit did not cause. This PR applies CI/CD principle 17, "Gate external state on pull requests; on push, warn":

| Finding | `pull_request` | `push` / `schedule` / `workflow_dispatch` |
|---|---|---|
| Pin older than the latest stable release (external state) | ❌ error, exit 1 | ⚠️ `::warning` + step summary, exit 0 |
| `*-latest` runner alias, missing actionlint release annotation, failed release lookup | ❌ error, exit 1 | ❌ error, exit 1 |

### Changes

- `scripts/src/WorkflowDependencies.php`: a new `findings()` method marks each finding as `outdated` or not, so the classification is structural rather than based on the message text. `check()` still returns plain messages. The new `report()` method emits annotations, writes a step summary that lists the bumps for warn-only runs, and returns the exit code.
- `scripts/check-workflow-dependencies.php`: the gate is enabled only when `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request`.
- `.github/dependabot.yml`: a weekly, grouped `github-actions` update with a 7-day cooldown, so the scheduled warning turns into a PR. Dependabot cannot see the zizmor `version` input, the `pipx run zizmor==` pin or the actionlint image annotation. Those stay with the weekly warning, and the step summary says so.
- The pins that the new pull-request gate reports on this PR were bumped. Otherwise this PR, which touches `.github/**`, would fail its own gate: `shivammathur/setup-php` 2.37.2 → 2.40.0, `github/codeql-action` v4.38.2 → v4.39.1, `zizmorcore/zizmor-action` v0.6.4 → v0.8.0 (its inputs are unchanged), and zizmor 1.30.1 → 1.31.1.
- Docs: `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and practice 13 in `docs/BEST-PRACTICES.md`, which still described major-version pins. Plus a changelog fragment.

## How to reproduce (before)

```bash
# Stub `gh` so every dependency looks outdated, then simulate a push run:
mkdir /tmp/stub && printf '#!/bin/sh\necho v999.0.0\n' > /tmp/stub/gh && chmod +x /tmp/stub/gh
PATH=/tmp/stub:$PATH GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push php scripts/check-workflow-dependencies.php; echo $?
# before: ::error:: ... exit 1      after: ::warning:: ... + summary, exit 0
# with GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request it still exits 1
```

## Tests

In `tests/Pipeline/WorkflowDependenciesTest.php`:
- `testScriptGatesOutdatedPinsOnlyOnPullRequests` runs the real script end to end over the real workflows with a stub `gh` on `PATH`. It expects exit 1 with `::error::` for `pull_request`, and exit 0 with `::warning::` plus a step summary for `push`, `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch`. **It fails against the old script** (verified locally: `push: ::error::…`).
- `testScriptStillFailsOnLookupFailuresOutsidePullRequests`: a failing `gh` still exits 1 on `schedule`.
- `testOnlyNewerUpstreamReleasesAreMarkedAsOutdated` and `testOutdatedPinsFailPullRequestsButOnlyWarnElsewhere` cover the classification and the reporting.
- `WorkflowPolicyTest` asserts that the Dependabot config exists and pins the bumped zizmor versions.

Local results: PHPUnit 132 tests OK, PHPStan OK, PHP-CS-Fixer clean, actionlint 1.7.12 clean, zizmor 1.31.1 with the CI settings (regular persona at medium confidence, plus the pedantic high/high pass) reports nothing. `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request php scripts/check-workflow-dependencies.php` (live) passes after the bumps.

## Notes

- Because of the cooldown, a contributor PR that touches `.github/**` can fail on a fresh upstream release for up to 7 days before Dependabot proposes it. That is the intended pull-request gate. The cooldown follows the issue's suggested config and zizmor's `dependabot-cooldown` audit.
title: Gate outdated workflow pins on pull requests, warn on push and schedule; add Dependabot

body:
Link checking treated rate limits and short server outages as permanent broken links. Hosted runner aliases and mixed action versions also made CI change without a repository diff. This PR retries transient failures, pins runner images, and adds a workflow dependency freshness check.

Fixes #18.

## Changes

- Throttle github.com link requests to two concurrent requests, one second apart, through `lychee.toml`.
- Retry unanswered HTTP requests, 429, and 5xx with exponential backoff, a 240-second budget, and at most eight rounds. Check the remaining budget between URLs and cap each request timeout to it. A permanent response such as 404 remains final; a persistent transient failure still fails the workflow.
- Fix the existing retry loop's missing waits. Require every failure to recover before setting `all_recovered`, so recovering one URL cannot suppress a separate 404. Deduplicate retry URLs and retain the archive lookup for failures that remain.
- Trigger link checking when its config, ignore list, or PHP implementation changes.
- Pin all hosted jobs to `ubuntu-24.04`; update checkout, Composer installation, Pages/artifact actions, CodeQL, dependency review, lychee, PHP setup, and zizmor to current stable release tags.
- Add a PHP freshness gate to `workflows.yml`, run it on relevant changes and weekly, and include it in the aggregate status job. It checks remote action refs (including sub-actions), the pinned actionlint release annotation, zizmor's input and `pipx` versions, and hosted runner aliases. Release lookups are deduplicated and API errors fail the check. CodeQL bundle tags and prereleases are excluded when selecting action releases.
- Add one patch changelog fragment as the automated release trigger and document the local freshness command.

## Reproduction and regression coverage

No external network is needed to reproduce the link bug:

```bash
vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Pipeline/LinkRecheckTest.php
vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Pipeline/LinkRecheckCliTest.php
vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Pipeline/WorkflowDependenciesTest.php
```

Before the fix, a mocked `503 -> 429 -> 200` sequence stopped at 503, and the retry timing/budget regressions failed. A separate localhost CLI regression run against the original script at `73c1ba1` also demonstrated that recovery of a connection reset incorrectly set `all_recovered=true` despite a 404 in the same report. The localhost fixture lives in `experiments/issue-18/link-server.php`; tests start and terminate it automatically.

Coverage includes transient status parsing, successful recovery, persistent failure, permanent failure after a transient response, exponential waits, remaining request budget, a finite zero-wait retry limit, duplicate URLs, mixed permanent/recovered reports, runner matrix aliases, stale actions/tool inputs, release selection, and failed API lookups.

The live freshness checker reported the existing runner aliases and outdated versions before the updates, then passed after them. The solution uses retries rather than accepting 429/5xx globally, so outages cannot turn into false successes.

## Validation

- `composer check`: 128 tests, 581 assertions; coding standards, PHPStan level 8, and file size checks pass. Local PHP is 8.5.10; PHPStan used a finite 512 MB limit because this machine's default 128 MB was insufficient.
- `composer validate --strict --no-check-version` passes.
- Actionlint 1.7.12 in the existing digest-pinned Docker image passes, including ShellCheck.
- Zizmor 1.30.1 passes both the regular audit and the configured pedantic high-severity/high-confidence audit.
- `php scripts/check-workflow-dependencies.php` passes against live GitHub releases.
- Final commit `be4402238edca33c8551454cd94887cdfdab76e2` passed all five workflows created at 2026-10-08 07:17:48 UTC: [CI/CD Pipeline](https://github.com/link-foundation/php-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/37742553541), [Workflows](https://github.com/link-foundation/php-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/37742553540), [Security](https://github.com/link-foundation/php-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/37742553436), [Docs](https://github.com/link-foundation/php-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/37742553547), and [Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/link-foundation/php-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/37742553457). There are 23 successful checks and three expected skips for release/deployment jobs. Each PHP 8.1–8.4 matrix job passed 128 tests and 581 assertions; lychee checked 59 links with zero errors.
title: Fix transient link checks and pin CI runners and dependencies

body:
## Summary

This pull request completes every requirement in the repository-mode umbrella issue.

### #14 — classify each cancelled job

The old gate asked only whether the branch had moved, which let that run-level fact excuse jobs that could not have been cancelled by a supersede.

- Read each cancelled job effective `concurrency.cancel-in-progress`, preferring job-level policy and falling back to workflow-level policy.
- Distinguish `true`, `false`, no concurrency group, missing jobs, and unknown/expression values without adding a runtime dependency.
- Excuse a cancellation only when the branch moved and that individual policy is literal `true`; every unreadable or ambiguous case fails closed.
- Resolve pull-request runs against their source SHA, branch, and repository rather than the synthetic `refs/pull/<n>/merge` ref in all five workflows.
- Treat any unexpected `needs` result as a failure instead of silently ignoring new result values.

### #15 — keep descendants from holding steps open

The old wrapper watched only the command root with `kill -0` and lent the process tree the CI step output descriptors.

- Capture stdout and stderr separately and relay bounded byte ranges, so survivors own only private files and cannot keep a caller pipeline open.
- Use an atomic status file for command completion and `ps` process-group membership for liveness, excluding zombies.
- Signal the whole process group, retry with passwordless `sudo` when privileged descendants remain, and escalate SIGTERM to SIGKILL.
- Report any final survivors instead of claiming they were terminated.
- Preserve the existing warning ratio, non-enforcing mode, heartbeat, command exit status, and exit 124 timeout contract; capture and sudo escalation can be disabled explicitly.

## Reproduction and verification

Before the fix:

- A cancelled job with literal `cancel-in-progress: false` exited the gate 0 whenever a newer branch SHA existed.
- A command that returned while a worker retained stdout made `wrapper | tee` exceed an external 3-second guard even though the wrapper reported completion.

Both cases are now end-to-end PHPUnit regressions. Additional tests cover parser precedence and every verdict, current versus superseded runs, fail-closed expressions, stream separation, command exit propagation, SIGTERM-to-SIGKILL escalation, and survivor cleanup.

Local verification:

- PHPUnit: 112 tests, 514 assertions
- PHPStan level 8: clean
- PHP-CS-Fixer: clean
- File-size policy: clean
- Bash syntax and diff whitespace: clean
- actionlint v1.7.12 pinned digest: clean

## Alternatives considered

- Removing the supersede exception is safe only for workflows that never cancel in progress and creates false positives elsewhere.
- Symfony YAML is a full parser but requires a Composer-installed vendor tree, which lightweight terminal gate jobs do not have.
- `yq` similarly adds a runner binary solely for two workflow keys.
- GNU `timeout` supplies deadlines and exit 124, but does not solve inherited CI output descriptors or privileged grandchildren.

A focused native-PHP indentation parser and the proven process-group/output-relay design from `link-foundation/box` fit this template without adding dependencies.

Fixes #14
Fixes #15
Fixes #16

## Summary

Delivers every currently open issue in one hardening pass, porting the
proven fixes from the sibling Python and JavaScript templates:

- **#5 — actionlint supply chain**: the analysis Docker image is pinned by
  digest (`sha256:b1934…5667`, `v1.7.12` in a comment); the mutable `1.7.x`
  tag was arbitrary code in a job that analyses credentials.
- **#6 — named zizmor version**: `version: 1.29.0` instead of the action's
  frozen `latest` table entry, plus a narrow pedantic pass
  (`--persona pedantic --min-severity high --min-confidence high`) so the
  Pedantic-only unpinned-image audit actually enforces `'*': hash-pin` on
  `uses: docker://` references.
- **#7 — Security workflow**: `composer audit --locked --abandoned=fail`
  against a freshly resolved set (the template ships no lock file), CodeQL
  over the workflow definitions (CodeQL has no PHP analyser),
  actions/dependency-review failing on high severity, weekly schedule.
- **#8 — credential persistence**: every checkout declares
  `persist-credentials`; only the two release jobs that push the version
  bump keep the token, each with a comment naming the push.
- **#9 — terminal status gate**: every workflow ends in a `pipeline-status`
  job observing every other job, so a `timeout-minutes` kill (reported by
  GitHub as `cancelled`) fails red on main unless the run was superseded by
  a newer commit (`scripts/check-pipeline-status.sh`).
- **#10 — execution budgets**: long steps run under
  `scripts/run-with-budget-warning.sh` (warning at 70%, SIGTERM → SIGKILL
  grace, exit 124); `uses:` steps carry step-level `timeout-minutes`; a
  policy test proves every budget expires before the job cap above it.
- **#11 — release preflight**: a job proves the release preconditions
  before the expensive work — Packagist registration via the p2 metadata
  GET the wait loop polls anyway, and the workflow token's push permission
  via the API. Refused preconditions block the release jobs; pull requests
  run in advisory report mode.
- **#12 — link re-check**: failures where no host ever answered
  (connect-phase resets, which lychee's `--max-retries` cannot retry —
  lycheeverse/lychee#2297) are re-asked outside lychee on a doubling wait
  within a budget. Status-code failures stay final; the Web Archive
  fallback drops recovered URLs; gates use the fail-safe `!= 'true'` form.

Each fix is pinned by regression tests in
`tests/Pipeline/WorkflowPolicyTest.php` (and
`ReleasePreflightTest.php` / `LinkRecheckTest.php` for the new logic), so a
future edit that re-introduces a known footgun fails locally.

## Test plan

- [x] `composer test` — 101 tests, 458 assertions
- [x] PHPStan level 8 clean
- [x] php-cs-fixer clean, file-size limit clean
- [x] actionlint (pinned digest image) clean
- [x] zizmor: regular pass 0 high, pedantic narrow pass clean
- [x] `composer check` / changeset validation passed
- [x] pipeline-status script hand-verified in main and non-main modes
- [x] recheck + preflight entrypoints smoke-tested locally

body:
## Summary

Implements a complete **native-PHP CI/CD pipeline template** for Symfony / Composer
PHP packages, closing #1. The pipeline reuses the best practices from the four
sibling templates (`js`, `rust`, `python`, `csharp` `-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template`)
and adapts them to the PHP / Composer / Packagist ecosystem. **Every CI/CD script
is native PHP** in [`scripts/`](scripts) — no Bash, Node or Python.

## What's included

- **Pipeline (native PHP):** thin `scripts/*.php` entry points over 20 tested
  classes in `scripts/src/` (PSR-4) — change detection, changeset creation +
  validation, version-modification guard, release decision, version/commit/tag,
  Packagist wait, idempotent GitHub Release, file-size guard, and a Wayback
  fallback for broken links.
- **Workflows:** `release.yml` (combined CI/CD), `docs.yml` (phpDocumentor →
  GitHub Pages), `links.yml` (lychee + archive fallback).
- **Quality gates:** PHP-CS-Fixer (`@PSR12` + `@PHP81Migration`), PHPStan **level 8**,
  PHPUnit across **PHP 8.1–8.4**, 1000-line file-size limit.
- **Changeset-style versioning:** conflict-free `changelog.d/` fragments drive
  semver; `CHANGELOG.md` and the version are owned by the pipeline.
- **Self-healing, idempotent releases:** git tag as the only idempotency guard;
  Packagist + GitHub Releases as the source of truth (Packagist publishes via
  webhook on tag push — no upload step).
- **Tests:** 67 tests / 170 assertions, including a `WorkflowPolicyTest` meta-test
  that asserts the workflow YAML never regresses (no cancel on `main`,
  `!cancelled()`, a timeout per job, native-PHP only, etc.).
- **Docs:** `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docs/index.md`,
  `docs/BEST-PRACTICES.md`, and the deep case study at
  `docs/case-studies/issue-1/README.md`.

## Issue requirements → where addressed

| # | Requirement | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | Reuse best practices from all four templates | ✅ |
| R2 | Compare all workflows/scripts across templates | ✅ `docs/case-studies/issue-1/` |
| R3 | CI/CD 100% native PHP in `./scripts` | ✅ |
| R4 | Collect issue data in `docs/case-studies/issue-1/` | ✅ |
| R5 | Deep case-study analysis + online research | ✅ |
| R6 | List every requirement | ✅ case study §1 |
| R7 | Per-requirement solution plans + library survey | ✅ case study §4–§5 |
| R8 | Deliver in this single PR | ✅ |

## Verification

```
composer check   # php-cs-fixer (clean) + phpstan L8 (0 errors) + file-size (ok) + 67 tests pass
```

Closes #1.
title: Symfony + Composer PHP AI-driven development pipeline template
